note: Every external protocol this node speaks, the version we DECLARE, the version that is CURRENT, and the day somebody last checked. Seeded 2026-09-04, the day the gate was written, after a capability audit that was wrong three times in one afternoon: it said the MCP v2 SDK did not exist (it does, as a package split rather than a version bump), that four A2A task states were missing (all eight were produced) and that task results carried no artifacts (they did). Every one of those was a guess where a checked date would have been an answer. Two entries are verified. The rest say untriaged, which is a question nobody has answered and not a clearance: an entry leaves that state by somebody reading the spec and writing what they found, never by re-seeding, which would forgive the whole list at once. `weDeclare` is checked against the code on every commit, so the ledger cannot drift from what the node actually says; `verifiedOn` is checked against maxAgeDays, so the ledger cannot go quietly stale.

verdicts.current: We declare what is current. Nothing to do.
verdicts.watch: A newer revision exists and we have decided not to move yet. The note says why and what would change the answer.
verdicts.adopt: We have decided to move. The note says what is left.
verdicts.decline: A newer revision exists and we will not follow it. The note says what we do instead.
verdicts.untriaged: Nobody has compared what we declare against what is current. Not a clearance.

protocols.name: Model Context Protocol
protocols.note: Served since 2026-10-20 (MCP SDK v2 migration, plan doc-mvguy322f9se): the node runs @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.3.x, and /v1/mcp and /v2/mcp/:role serve two eras on one URL. A request carrying the 2026-07-28 `_meta` envelope is served statelessly by the SDK's createMcpHandler (src/mcp/modern-endpoint.ts): server/discover, tools, resources, prompts and subscriptions/listen, with the standard-header and envelope checks; any other request keeps the 2025-era session code (src/mcp/legacy-sessions.ts), whose initialize negotiates 2025-11-25, 2025-06-18, 2025-03-26, 2024-11-05 or 2024-10-07. We declare 2026-07-28, the highest; both server cards state it and list every served revision in supportedProtocolVersions (src/mcp/protocol-version.ts, MCP_SERVED_REVISIONS). test/unit/mcp-protocol-version.test.ts holds the literal to what server/discover names and the list to what initialize negotiates, so an SDK upgrade that moves either fails on the day of the upgrade; test/e2e-mcp-modern.ts covers the stateless path end to end. Not served yet: MCP Tasks on 2026-07-28, which waits for the SDK (plan step 11). History: the cards said 2025-06-18 until 2026-10-19 while the server negotiated 2025-11-25, and the version was then written out twice.

protocols.name: Agent2Agent
protocols.note: We serve 1.x through @a2a-js/sdk (A2A_PROTOCOL_VERSION) and declare 0.3 BESIDE it, deliberately: almost every client in the world still speaks 0.3, the SDK ships the compatibility layer, and the card declares both interfaces so a client reading either finds an address. The value tracked here is the legacy one, because it is the one written out by hand. Surface as of 2026-09-04: streaming on, push notifications on, extended agent card on, all eight task states produced, artifacts on the task, x402 extension declared.

protocols.name: Agent-User Interaction
protocols.note: The third door onto one task, beside A2A and ACP: a browser watches an agent work over SSE. Until 2026-09-20 this declared `0.0.59`, the npm version of @ag-ui/core, which is not a version of AG-UI at all and told a client nothing about the wire. @ag-ui/core 1.0.0 freezes the schema and publishes PROTOCOL_VERSION 1.0; we declare that. Surface as of 2026-09-20: RUN_STARTED, TEXT_MESSAGE_START/CONTENT/END, RUN_FINISHED and RUN_ERROR, every line of the task its own message. The events we do not emit are the ones this node has nothing to say for: no state snapshots or deltas, no tool-call or reasoning events, no activity events. One-way, because AG-UI is a run that emits until it settles and the task has the same shape. test/unit/agui-protocol-version.test.ts holds the literal against the package, so a protocol move fails at the upgrade rather than on this register's 90-day clock.

Discovery (/.well-known/aimeat and GET / this_node) states protocol_version 2026-11 and the claimed profiles from node 4.0.0 and leaves both out before it (services/core-discovery.ts CORE_PROTOCOL_FROM), because a 3.x node does not yet keep the edition's removals. Ruling decision-core-2026-11-avoimet-kysymykset-ja-agenttien-automaattinen-l Q2.
